derivedFrom: marketing/03-visual-identity/DA.md + website/app/globals.css (SSOT: the CSS is canon, R-CITE)
concept: Black-craft, Apple-grade precision, a monochrome near-black system that looks like the native macOS app it sells

roles.note: 60/30/10 per spec §2.1.5, dominant near-black neutral / secondary chrome / one signature accent. WCAG AA 4.5:1 for text.
roles.accent10: accent #f4ede0 for one key element per frame; rec #ff5a4d ONLY for the record dot / the one live moment, never both accents loud in the same frame

eyebrow.usage: RARE, a handful per set, never 16

type.scaleRatio: 96px:40px (2.4x jump display→body per spec §2.1.4, a real jump not a 1.2x step)
type.note: 2 families max, both from the Apple SF Pro stack (Inter fallback). No exotic/decorative fonts, DA DON'T. Pixel minimums are for the 1080x1920 master (spec §2.1.4 headline≥40px-equiv on canvas; on a 1080-wide master a display line lands ~96-180px).

emphasis.note: rec-dot slow pulse; the one live accent

recPulse.note: the record dot #ff5a4d breathes gently, the single signature motion

motion.reducedMotion: static rec dot (no pulse), instant reveals, keep hierarchy legible

meta.note: unified Stories/Reels March 2026, critical elements out of top 270px / bottom 670px Reels

photo.lens: 35mm context / 50mm product / 100mm macro on UI detail
photo.light: single soft directional key, low-key matte, near-black room, one motivated source, quiet
photo.grain: faint fine grain (feTurbulence ~0.12 in-app; Kodak Gold 200 grain for any lensed shot)
photo.materials: matte anodized aluminium, dark glass, MacBook Pro / iMac Apple Silicon, sober dev desk
photo.surfaces: near-black #050507 field; crisp real UI screenshots on #0c0c10 macOS-window panels, hairline borders, NO blur
photo.seriesLock: one focal length + one light recipe + this palette + this grain repeated VERBATIM across every asset of a series (spec §2.2 series discipline)
photo.subjectDoctrine: product-led / scene-led, NO stock people, NO recurring human avatar (avatar-soul.md). The recurring mark is the MicMark glyph + the #ff5a4d rec-dot.

logo.mark: MicMark, micro glyph inside a black rounded square (radius ~0.26x size), from website/components/Brand.tsx
logo.bannerUse: horizontal lockup (MicMark + Verba wordmark, SF Pro 600)
logo.separator: MotifRule (a thin rule carrying the mark)

avatar.decision: scene-led / product-led, no recurring human avatar (marketing/03-visual-identity/higgsfield/avatar-soul.md). Generate WITHOUT --soul-id.
avatar.note: see avatar-persona.md for the scene-led approach + the conditional-founder brief (NOT trained now)
